import math
def arc(cx,cy,r,a0,a1,n=8,skip=False):
    return [[cx+r*math.cos(math.radians(a0+(a1-a0)*i/n)), cy+r*math.sin(math.radians(a0+(a1-a0)*i/n))] for i in range(1 if skip else 0, n+1)]
prof=[[0,0],[36.5,0],[38.5,2],[38.5,65.4]]
prof+=arc(36.5,65.4,2,0,90,skip=True)
prof+=[[37.6,67.4]]
prof+=arc(37.6,69.4,2,270,180,skip=True)
prof+=[[35.6,80.9]]
prof+=arc(34.1,80.9,1.5,0,90,skip=True)
prof+=arc(34.5,80.9,1.5,90,180,skip=True)
prof+=[[33,72],[35,70],[35,5.4]]
prof+=arc(32,5.4,3,0,-90,skip=True)
prof+=[[0,2.4]]
for p in prof: print([round(x,3) for x in p])
from shapely.geometry import Polygon
pg=Polygon(prof)
print('valid', pg.is_valid, 'simple', pg.exterior.is_simple, pg.is_valid)
import shapely.validation as sv
print(sv.explain_validity(pg))
